baseline_policy.rule: A raw-zero empty C-slot readout is a camera sentinel, not a writable rollback fixture. Do not claim restoration to it.
baseline_policy.C3: Use the manually overwritten, camera-accepted configuration as the replacement baseline.
baseline_policy.C4: Use C4 PTP VERIFY as the replacement baseline.
baseline_policy.C5_C7: Use intentional complete copies of the C4 PTP VERIFY replacement baseline.
